wallet_reference.source: Previously supplied by owner; current linkage and control not independently verified

mcp.authentication: Must be completed by the user through Binance's supported authorization flow; this repository does not contain an authenticated session

verification_runbook.step_1: Open the Agent ID URL and verify the page's displayed identity and account association while signed in to Binance.
verification_runbook.step_2: In a supported MCP client, add https://agent.binance.com/mcp/agentic and complete Binance's authorization flow; grant minimum scopes, with trading and transfer scopes omitted unless separately approved.
verification_runbook.step_3: Capture a non-secret success indicator from the client showing the authenticated session is connected. Do not put tokens, QR pairing codes, auth codes, cookies, or secrets in GitHub.
verification_runbook.step_4: Verify wallet control separately using a provider-supported signed challenge or another authoritative ownership proof. Do not sign arbitrary messages or transactions just to satisfy this checklist.
verification_runbook.step_5: Update this registry only after the corresponding evidence is independently observed and reviewed.

note: Repository metadata is not an authentication mechanism. The public Agent ID URL does not by itself prove account linkage, an authenticated MCP session, or control of the referenced Ethereum address.
